dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pixie arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Pixie has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to have a tense body, pinned back ears, and whale eye. During her assessments when a handler attempted to interact with her, Pixie became tense and frozen. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experincved adult only home.
dog.name: Pixie
